recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. Any future edits should be scoped to later, specific workflow issues such as FHIR-40500 for instantiates removal or FHIR-48444 for CarePlan contributor/custodian mapping, not reopened under FHIR-14446.
issue_request: FHIR-14446 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked Patient Care to clear workflow-report issues across CarePlan, ClinicalImpression, Communication, CommunicationRequest, Condition, FamilyMemberHistory, and Procedure. The approved work included mapping and suppression changes, CarePlan activity doNotPerform/statusReason updates, CommunicationRequest doNotPerform/statusReason and performer mapping updates, ClinicalImpression workflow alignment, CarePlan status/intent and author/contributor handling, instantiates target updates, and Procedure.performer.function.
initial_application: Historical source commits explicitly applied GF#14446: 49fa35a and fa3c52b handled early CarePlan activity and workflow-warning work; 0b3156f applied the main mapping, binding, element, and exception changes; and f235b25 applied the final June 2018 vote including CommunicationRequest.recipient, CarePlan contributor/author, instantiates target updates, and Procedure.performer.function.
additional_context: The affected resources are active in source/fhir.ini. Current source no longer literally has every 2018 element name because later applied work changed those surfaces: CarePlan.author became CarePlan.custodian with CarePlan.contributor, FHIR-48444 clarified contributor/custodian FiveWs mapping, and FHIR-40500 removed top-level instantiates[x] from several PC resources in favor of precise workflow extensions. Community and Confluence records support the Jira votes and reveal no conflicting later requirement for this seed.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative XML and mapping-exception files already carry the required workflow alignment: CarePlan status/intent, custodian/contributor, activity statusReason and doNotPerform; CommunicationRequest statusReason, doNotPerform, recipient to Request.performer, and category not as Request.code; ClinicalImpression status/statusReason/effective alignment; Condition.asserter no longer as Event.performer.actor; FamilyMemberHistory Event.occurrence exemption; Communication.recipient actor mapping; and Procedure.performer.function.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 workflow-pattern issue removed top-level instantiates[x] from PC resources after FHIR-14446, explaining why current source should not re-add those old elements. Already represented on the combined branch.
